_meta.conventions: All money values are $ per $100 of year-1 list spend. null means Infinity (payback 'never', volume multiple / required attach 'not recoverable', break-even 'unbounded', cliff 'unbounded') except grid[].contributionPct and equityUplift, where null means n/a. lifetime[type][years] holds lifetime(p, {...incentive, type}, {...lifetime, years}) with payback = paybackMonths; rows are given for years = 5. requiredAttach uses the base lifetime (years as in params). Scenario overrides replace base values (includeAdjacency 1 -> true). counterfactual: requiredWinLift[rate] = matchThreshold(npvOneTime5, npvNone5, rate) from sensitivity.ts; recurringAiOnly / recurringWithAdjacency = recurring NPV with includeAdjacency false / true, years 1, 3, 5.
